title: 科技与创新词汇
goal: 辨认科技与创新词汇，准确表达技术应用及作用。

points.label: 选择保留技术应用及作用的表达

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 说明科技应用时，要分清研发、推广、普及和效率的变化。develop 是研发。promote 是推广，指把技术介绍给别人。adopt 是采用，指对方开始使用。

body.box:
研究团队开发软件，并向学校推广。部分学校采用后，登记资料所需的时间减少。
A research team developed software and promoted it to schools. After some schools adopted it, recording information took less time.

body.p: promoted 是推广，adopted 是采用。原文说的是部分学校采用后时间减少了，没有说所有学校都在使用。

body.box:
研究团队开发了一套设备，用于监测水位。设备先在两个站点试用，随后向其他站点推广。试用期间，工作人员记录数据所需的时间减少，但材料未说明所有站点均已采用。
A research team developed equipment to monitor water levels. It was first tested at two sites and then promoted to other sites. During the trial, staff spent less time recording data; the account does not say that all sites adopted the equipment.

body.p: developed 是研发，tested 是试用，promoted 是推广。记录数据的时间减少，是试用期间的结果。

body.box:
What does the account report about the trial?
1. Every site adopted the equipment.
2. Recording data took less staff time.
3. The equipment was tested at all sites.
4. The team spent less time developing the equipment.

body.p: 原文 staff spent less time recording data，工作人员记录数据的时间少了，即第二项。第一项把推广当成了全部采用。

groups.fill: A team built a tool to record temperatures. The resea{rchers} tested the prot{otype}, an early model, in a labor{atory}, revised the soft{ware}, and shared the res{ults} of the test, its findings, with a hosp{ital}. Hospital staff then used the dev{ice} to enter readings into a data{base}. Their feed{back} helped the team identify one needed impro{vement}. The account describes a trial and a proposed revision; it does not claim that the tool is already used at every hospital.
notes: improvement：one needed improvement 指需要做的一处改进。

groups.text:
A Trial Service

A library developed an online booking system. It tested the system with one group of readers before promoting it to other branches. During the trial, readers spent less time reserving seats. The report does not state that all branches adopted the system.

options: A system for booking seats online
A report on seat use at all branches
A trial group of regular readers
A seat plan for the other branches
items.why: 原文 A library developed an online booking system，后文说读者用它 reserving seats，研发的是网上订座系统，即第一项。
原文 tested the system with one group of readers before promoting it to other branches，先试用的是一组读者，即第二项。其他分馆是试用之后才推广的。

options: Testing the system with a group of readers
Making all branches use the system
Introducing the system to other branches
items.why: promoting it to other branches 是把系统介绍给其他分馆，即第三项。原文末句说没有说明所有分馆都采用了，所以第二项不对。

options: Readers spent more time in their seats.
Reserving a seat took readers less time.
items.why: 原文 During the trial, readers spent less time reserving seats，变化的是订座用的时间，即第四项。第二项把时间减少说成了订座数量减少。
all branches adopted the system 说的是各分馆是否开始使用这个系统，adopted 是采用，即第二项。第一项是推广，是图书馆做的事。

groups.fill: A clinic tested a digital appointment system. The cli{nic} used a plat{form} to collect requ{ests} from pati{ents}. Staff checked each req{uest} before sending a confir{mation}. The sys{tem} stored the appoi{ntment} details in a data{base}, and a rep{ort} described the trial results. The report measured the time staff spent on scheduling at the clinic during the trial. It did not claim that every clinic had adopted the system or that every patient preferred online services.

groups.text:
Testing an Appointment System

A health center developed an online appointment system with help from a local research group. The system lets patients request an available time, while staff check each request before confirming it. The center first tested the system with patients at one branch. Staff continued to accept telephone requests during the trial, so online booking did not replace every other method.

The trial report compared the time spent recording appointment requests before and after the system was introduced at that branch. Staff spent less time on this recording task during the trial. The report did not measure the length of medical consultations or claim that patients recovered more quickly. It described a change in one administrative task.

After the trial, the team introduced the system to several other branches and provided training to their staff. Some branches adopted it, while others continued to consider whether it met their needs. Introducing a system to a branch and having that branch use it are separate events. The report gave no figure for the proportion of all branches using it.

中文信息：研究人员协助开发网上预约系统。一个门诊试用后，工作人员记录预约所需时间减少。团队向其他门诊推广系统，部分门诊采用，报告未说明全部采用。

items.stem: Where was the system tested first?
items.why: 原文 The center first tested the system with patients at one branch，最先试用只在一个门诊，即第二项。第四项是试用之后推广的地方。

items.stem: What task took less staff time?
items.why: spent less time on this recording task 指记录预约。

items.stem: What does adopted mean in the final paragraph?
options: Started using the system for bookings
Received the system and staff training
Considered whether it met their needs
Tested the system with their patients
items.why: Some branches adopted it, while others continued to consider，adopted 与 consider 相对，指开始使用这个系统，即第一项。第二项是推广时团队做的事，原文说推广和使用是两回事。

options: All branches adopted it immediately after receiving training.
Telephone requests stopped at every branch.
The team introduced the system to more branches.
items.why: introduced the system to several other branches 对应推广行动。

items.stem: What is a trial in this account?
options: A permanent replacement of all telephone booking
A test of the system at one branch
A count of all branches using the system
items.why: first tested ... at one branch 说明 trial 是试用。
